claims.claim: Original Ambro Brother embroidery Sewing machine
claims.evidence: The witness identified the brand as 'AIG BROTHER' and the model as 'AIG-8800D', which is an industrial lockstitch machine, not an embroidery machine.
AIG Brother is typically a Chinese-manufactured brand; no 'Made in Japan' markings were reported by the witness.
The motor was not shown or tested in the report.

claims.claim: All accessories and the original manual
claims.evidence: The report does not mention a manual or specific accessory kit, only thread spools.

claims.claim: Never serviced because nothing ever went wrong
claims.evidence: Internal service history cannot be confirmed via photos.

risks.risk: The motor may be an older, noisy clutch motor rather than a modern energy-saving servo motor.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the motor unit mounted under the table.
risks.if_unproven: as equipped with a basic, used clutch motor.

risks.risk: Internal components or the oil pan may be rusted, contaminated, or leaking.
risks.proof: A photo of the machine head tilted back showing the oil pan and internal gears.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring a full internal cleaning and oil system flush.

risks.risk: The machine may have timing issues or skipped stitches.
risks.proof: A video clip of the machine sewing through at least two layers of fabric.

proof_requests: Video of the machine running and sewing a sample stitch.
Photo of the motor under the table to identify if it is clutch or servo.
Photo of the underside of the machine head (oil pan area).
Photo of any 'Made in...' markings on the casting or sticker.
response.reason: The witness successfully identified the specific brand and model (AIG-8800D), allowing for a baseline valuation as a standard Chinese-made industrial lockstitch machine despite the seller's inaccurate brand and type descriptions.
